Nora (CS): Heads-up: ZenithAI onboarding — flagged as at-risk for renewal unless we reduce unit costs. Seeing increasing p95 and token spend on their summary endpoint. proposing a targeted perf play.
Isa (ML Eng): What are the numbers?
Nora (CS): Onboarding completion ~58%. Route 'summarize_short' has p50 ~80ms, p95 ~510ms at peak. Token spend +22% month-over-month, driven by long retention of system+instruction context and many short responses (avg 9 tokens).
Sam (AE): Renewal up in 2 months, CFO care about margins. Any customer complaints yet?
Nora (CS): Not yet, but they monitor cost closely. Suggested options: prefix caching, swap to compact int8 model for non-sensitive traffic, tweak routing to separate long-horizon routes.
Diego (SRE): Any errors or memory pressure?
Isa (ML Eng): No OOMs. I ran a quick offline eval (500 samples from production): compact-2b-int8 shows ~2.1% drop in semantic-match on one edge case bucket (legal-ese), but on generic summaries delta ~0.4%. We can mitigate by routing legal-ese to current model and rest to compact.
Nora (CS): Good. Customer primarily uses generic docs ingestion, only ~8% legal.
Sam (AE): If we can show ~25-30% cost savings with guardrails for legal traffic, that's a solid renewal argument.
Isa (ML Eng): Proposed minimal-risk rollout: create a route filter for 'summarize_short' and attach a weighted routing policy: 85% current-large, 15% compact-2b-int8. Enable prefix cache with 45s TTL for repeated session prefixes. Add a rule: if input matches legal-tag (metadata) route to current-large. Canary 72h, metric gates: rollback if p95 > 650ms or accept_rate delta > 3%.
Diego (SRE): I can implement the routing policy and alerts in Redwood Console. I'll put autoscale headroom + an automated rollback play if gateways spike. Also will add a synthetic probe that mimics shortest-path summaries.
Nora (CS): Action items: 1) @Isa run canary + eval harness and produce small eval report, 2) @Diego apply routing + cache config and set alerts, 3) @Sam prep renewal messaging including projected savings and contingency plan, 4) I'll collect user feedback via an in-app thumbs prompt after 10 interactions.
Isa (ML Eng): Canary config I'll use (informal):
```
route: summarize_short
strategy: weighted
weights:
  current: 85
  compact-2b-int8: 15
prefix_cache: true
kv_ttl_ms: 45000
metrics: [p95_latency, cost_per_1k_tokens, semantic_match, accept_rate]
rollback: p95 > 650ms || semantic_match_drop > 3%
canary_window_hours: 72
```
Diego (SRE): ops-bot will post deploy events and link dashboard. I'll add an extra trace span to track routing decision time.
ops-bot: Canary started for zenithai/summarize_short (85/15). Dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/teams/zenithai/dash/2765432109
Nora (CS): I'll also ask the success contact to opt-in to a short feedback microsurvey after the change so we can capture qualitative differences.
Sam (AE): I'll prepare a 1-pager for their finance lead with conservative and optimistic savings scenarios and the rollback play.
Isa (ML Eng): Early canary update (18h): compact-2b-int8 traffic shows -29% cost_per_1k_tokens, p95 reduced by ~110ms on canary traffic, semantic_match delta +0.2% (within tolerance). Full logs and CSV uploaded to shared drive.
Diego (SRE): Alerts stable, no rollback triggers. I recommend raising compact weight to 35% after 5 days stable and keep legal-tag routing strict.
Nora (CS): Great progress. I'll mark renewal risk as reduced to monitor and schedule enablement session with ZenithAI ops next week. Thanks team :raised_hands:
